title: Stack order: desktop Dart first, Windows runner second, release pipeline last
context: decisions.md first said the release pipeline ships first, but the items stacked it last. The spec reviewer flagged the contradiction.
options: Desktop Dart, then runner, then pipeline
outcome: Desktop, runner, pipeline. Shipped first, the pipeline's own pull-request Windows build would fail because no windows/ folder exists yet. Shipped last, its pull-request build compiles the whole stack on windows-latest and produces the installer for the VM lab check. decisions.md line 15 was rewritten to say so.
